inputs.description: Inputs into the workflow that is being optimized

title:
The {@link Workflow.MlPipeline.ExpandSync} optimization replace all {@link MlAtomicPipe#trainSync} and
{@link MlAtomicPipe#processSync} action vertices with their corresponding {@link MlAtomicPipe#expandedTrainWorkflow}
and {@link MlAtomicPipe#expandedProcessWorkflow} workflows. This optimization can only be applied after
{@link Workflow.VertexFusion}, and operates on the {@link Workflow.Const} input of
{@link VertexFusion#executeFusedVertex} action vertices.
name: Workflow.MlPipeline.ExpandSync
